newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's Q3 c/a deficit shrinks to 20.8 mln dinars.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's Q3 c/a deficit shrinks to 20.8 mln dinars.

text.p: Jordan's third quarter current account deficit shrunk to 20.8 million dinars ($29.4 million) in the third quarter of 1996 from a revised 196 million in the second quarter, the Central Bank's monthly bulletin said.

The third quarter figures were helped by a cut in import payments from the second quarter after decreases in world grain prices. A six percent increase in workers remittances to 264.5 million dinars helped boost net receipts from services to 347.6 million dinars.
Overall balance of payments, including capital account, swung into the black with a 57.6 million dinar surplus, compared to a 127.2 million dinar deficit in the second quarter.
A near doubling of private short-term investment to 26.2 million dinars helped boost the third quarter capital account.
